messages:
maya: kicking off a mini staged rollout for rwd-infer -> v2.5.2 at 12% (apac + us-west). change window until 02:00 UTC. watchlist: apac-edge 5xx, embed recall, p95 tail. stop rules: apac 5xx > 0.8% for 4m OR embed-recall drop >4% vs baseline for 10m. please ack and stand by.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started job=job-6138 target=12% version=v2.5.2 regions=[apac,us-west] dashboard=https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/job-6138 actions: /deploy pause job-6138 | /deploy abort job-6138 | /deploy rollback job-6138 --to v2.5.1

luis: quick heads-up: apac-edge 500s jumped to 0.5% ~1m ago, looks correlated with a small cache miss flood. not at threshold yet.

noah: running an embed similarity sweep on a representative prompt set; will report delta in 5m.

maya: preemptively locking ramp. pausing any auto-nudge. /deploy pause job-6138

deploy-bot: job-6138 paused by maya (manual hold). traffic remains at 12%. rollback command staged: /deploy rollback job-6138 --to v2.5.1

eng-oncall: infra healthy (no host restarts). p95 +28ms. apac error-rate trending up with cache misses; could be new KV client behavior in v2.5.2.

luis: opened quick PR: https://git.redwood/infer/PR-1666 "revert kv-client bump for staged cohorts". includes smoke test matrix and a short rollback checklist.

maya: add a short support blurb in release notes so CS knows how to identify impacted traffic and communicate to customers.

ops-bot: release notes append: "v2.5.2 staged rollout: observed apac-edge cache miss cascade; holding at 12%. Rollback trigger: apac 5xx >0.8% for 4m OR embed recall drop >4% for 10m. Rollback target: v2.5.1. Playbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/playbooks/rollback-kvclient"

noah: embed recall delta after 6m: -1.2% on hold set. nothing close to the 4% stop. I'll continue longer-run checks.

luis: if we hit threshold we should rollback and pin runtime to v2.5.1 for staged cohorts. PR ready to merge on decision.

maya: agreed. holding for 15m total. if no threshold breaches we'll do a controlled bump to 30% with notice. acks?

eng-oncall: ack  monitoring dashboards and traces. will escalate if patterns widen.

noah: ack  running extended embed eval and smoke prompts.

deploy-bot: snapshot: apac 5xx=0.47%, us-west 5xx=0.04%, p95 delta=+29ms, embed recall delta=-1.2%. paused. awaiting manual resume/rollback.

maya: thanks team. schedule end-of-hold decision in 15m from now for go/no-go."
